name: Arkyos Angel
source:
In this game you are an angel and the princess of a supernatural kingdom called Arkyos. You were raised away from your kingdom for your own protection, but now that you are eighteen your parents ask for your return. Everything should go smoothly, but your friends are murdered and you must flee. 
How and with whom will your future be? Will you become the queen of Arkyos?

[Translated from [url=https://kiyomiiharts.wixsite.com/arkyosangel]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你是一名天使，也是名为阿基奥斯的超自然王国的公主。为了保护你，你从小被安排远离王国；如今你年满18岁，父母要求你回国。一切本应顺利进行，但你的朋友遭到杀害，你必须逃亡。

你的未来会如何，又会和谁在一起？你能成为阿基奥斯的女王吗？

[译自[url=https://kiyomiiharts.wixsite.com/arkyosangel]官方网站[/url]]
